title: Executive Order 14433: Eliminating Disease-Carrying Pests and Restoring Enjoyment of the Great Outdoors
summary: Executive Order 14433, "Eliminating Disease-Carrying Pests and Restoring Enjoyment of the Great Outdoors", was signed on 2026-09-29 and published in the Federal Register on 2026-10-02 (91 FR 63125).
